title: Level 40 Wellness
description: Dubai's first wellness-integrated café online — café dining, nutritionist-guided meal plans, retail store with cart & checkout, and workshops in one brand experience.
problem: The café was managing bookings over WhatsApp, inventory on spreadsheets, and had no online presence. Customers couldn't discover their menu or book sessions easily.
solution: We built a sleek, mobile-first web platform with online ordering, session booking, a product store, and an owner-managed CMS — no developer needed for day-to-day updates.

title: Mudkraft
description: A pottery studio taken online. The owner manages the whole catalogue from an admin panel; customers browse, add to cart and enquire directly on WhatsApp — no developer needed.
problem: The pottery artist was selling only through Instagram DMs and local markets. No way to showcase the full catalogue, handle payments online, or track orders systematically.
solution: We designed a beautiful storefront that reflects the artisan brand, paired with a powerful admin panel for inventory, order management, and customer outreach — all owner-managed.

title: Valley of Birds
description: Platform for a Kumaon bird-expedition guide — treks, gallery and social channels in one place, enquiry-to-confirmation flow, and every lead consolidated in a single view.
problem: The expedition company relied on word-of-mouth and basic social media. They had no system for capturing interested leads, showcasing upcoming trips, or managing bookings.
solution: We built a visually rich platform that showcases expeditions with stunning imagery, captures leads through smart forms, and gives the owner a simple dashboard to manage trips and inquiries.

title: Bharat Laundry
description: Doorstep laundry app — customers schedule pickups online, the owner manages orders from an admin portal, and auto-generated cloth tags mean garments never get mixed.
problem: The laundry business was managing pickups via phone calls and WhatsApp. No tracking, no automated pricing, and frequent missed orders due to manual coordination.
solution: We engineered a two-sided platform: a customer app for scheduling pickups with real-time tracking, and an admin portal for managing orders, assigning drivers, setting pricing rules, and monitoring operations.
